enunciado: Evaluate postfix (reverse Polish) expressions whose tokens come in a string array: "3 4 + 2 *" and "5 1 2 + 4 * + 3 -". Show the stack after each token of the second one.
objetivos: Evaluate parenthesis-free expressions with a stack
pistas: An operator pops b, then a, and pushes a op b.
At the end the stack holds a single value: the result.
